//: AI playing styles (nicknames, never real players). short is the scoreboard name in doubles; level is added to the match's AI level; the rest scale the AI's choices: net (how readily its pair takes the net), lob, drop (drop shots and chiquitas), smash (smash rather than bandeja), vibora (víbora rather than bandeja), margin (how far it keeps from lines and walls; lower is riskier), pace (drives, slices, lobs and mid-height volleys: above 0 that share x0.5 hit hard, and drives chosen over slices more; below 0 the reverse with power, below 0 played safe with precision; 0 neither). The sim's default is the neutral 'reloj'; the game deals styles from the seed.
